title: Deployment Failure Investigation, Recovery, and Improvement
variantPolicy: Seeded variants change operational constraints while preserving competencies and solvability. Variants are not independent published assets.

exercises.title: Construct the Incident Timeline
exercises.objective: Produce a causally useful UTC timeline instead of a list of uncorrelated errors.
exercises.initialState: A migrate-data deployment failed and OCC is unavailable.
exercises.prompt: Create a timeline that identifies the change, first causal evidence, downstream symptoms, business impact, operator actions, and uncertainty. Incorporate the supplied variant constraints.
constraints: do not include secrets or customer data
exercises.deliverable: A timestamped incident timeline and two competing hypotheses.
acceptanceCriteria: build, commit, migration mode and deployment ID

hints.text: Begin with deployment identity and a single UTC clock.
Separate the first correlated error from readiness and health symptoms.
For each hypothesis, name evidence that would disprove it.

exercises.referenceSolution: Anchor the timeline on deployment ID, build, commit, migrate-data mode, first correlated migration error, activation/readiness effects, business transaction window, and operator actions. Label each causal statement as observed or inferred and define falsifying evidence.

exercises.title: Defend a Recovery Decision
exercises.objective: Choose among corrected roll-forward, previous-build deployment, and restore using explicit evidence.
exercises.initialState: Schema migration started before failure; old-build compatibility is unproven.
exercises.prompt: Write a recovery decision record using the variant RPO, traffic, support, and external-state constraints.
exercises.deliverable: Decision, rejected alternatives, preconditions, risks, and acceptance tests.

hints.text: List what each recovery option changes in application and persistent state.
Use backup age and external side effects to quantify divergence.
State the evidence that permits or rejects the prior build.

exercises.referenceSolution: Prefer a rehearsed corrected roll-forward when the defect is repairable and data divergence makes restore costly. Retain supported restore as contingency, reject an old build without schema evidence, engage SAP Support for managed database intervention, and verify technical plus transactional recovery.

exercises.title: Repair a Dangerous Deployment Runbook
exercises.objective: Find unsafe assumptions and convert a generic runbook into evidence-led control flow.
exercises.initialState: The runbook says: retry deployment, deploy previous build, clear caches, then initialize if still broken.
exercises.prompt: Review and rewrite the runbook. Explain each removed action and include variant-aware escalation and communication.
constraints: every branch needs entry and exit evidence
exercises.deliverable: Defect list and corrected ordered runbook.

hints.text: Identify actions that mutate evidence or persistent state before diagnosis.
Add explicit decision gates for compatibility and backup scope.
Assign ownership and a next-update time.

exercises.referenceSolution: Replace retries and destructive fallbacks with command assignment, change freeze, chronology, first-error analysis, schema and backup decision gates, supported SAP escalation, controlled recovery, business reconciliation, acceptance checks, and scheduled communication.

exercises.title: Build the Compatibility Test Matrix
exercises.objective: Turn an additive-schema claim into executable release evidence.
exercises.initialState: A release adds a type, relation, defaulted attribute, process state, and deployment mapping.
exercises.prompt: Design migration, mixed-version, rollback/forward, and business tests, including fixtures and expected evidence under the supplied variant.
exercises.deliverable: Versioned test matrix with setup, action, assertions, and retained evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: old code on migrated state where supported

hints.text: Use code version and persistent-state version as separate test dimensions.
Include records created before, during, and after migration.
Assert business behavior, not only successful startup.

exercises.referenceSolution: Create a two-dimensional code/state matrix, production-like fixtures, migration assertions, mixed-version read/write tests, process and integration checks, selected restore and corrected-forward rehearsals, and immutable evidence tied to build and schema versions.

exercises.title: Review Sensitive Incident Evidence
exercises.objective: Preserve useful diagnostics without exposing credentials, payment data, or customer information.
exercises.initialState: An engineer proposes pasting unrestricted production logs into an external AI assistant and a shared ticket.
exercises.prompt: Design a secure evidence workflow that preserves correlation and technical value while respecting access boundaries and the variant incident urgency.
constraints: do not destroy original authorized evidence
exercises.deliverable: Classification, redaction, storage, access, and sharing procedure.

hints.text: Separate the authoritative evidence store from a redacted working extract.
List identifiers that preserve correlation without exposing payloads.
Treat external AI as a separate data processor requiring approval.

exercises.referenceSolution: Preserve originals in authorized systems, produce a redacted derivative with time and correlation fields, remove secrets and regulated data, restrict access and retention, document transformations, and prohibit external AI submission without approved processing controls.

exercises.title: Reject a False JVM Diagnosis
exercises.objective: Use temporal evidence to distinguish deployment failure from JVM or database pressure.
exercises.initialState: OCC errors rise after activation fails; heap drops when processes exit; GC and connection waits were normal beforehand.
exercises.prompt: Evaluate the memory-pressure hypothesis, identify missing evidence, and define a minimal metric/log correlation plan appropriate to the variant traffic profile.
constraints: do not infer causality from one chart
exercises.deliverable: Hypothesis assessment, alternative hypotheses, queries, and falsification criteria.

hints.text: Ask which signal moved first.
Compare against the same traffic profile and release baseline.
Correlate process exit with the apparent heap improvement.

exercises.referenceSolution: Reject heap pressure as the leading cause because JVM and database indicators did not deteriorate first. Correlate deployment events, process lifecycle, first error, service health, traffic-adjusted latency, and business success rates in one UTC window.

exercises.title: Design the Post-Recovery Acceptance Suite
exercises.objective: Prove commerce service and data recovery beyond HTTP health.
exercises.initialState: A corrected build starts successfully after failed migration.
exercises.prompt: Define technical, business, integration, data, search, security, and monitoring checks. Prioritize them for the variant business window and external state.
constraints: no irreversible test data in production
exercises.deliverable: Ordered acceptance suite with owner, expected result, evidence, and stop condition.

hints.text: A green health endpoint verifies only one boundary.
Use a known product and controlled transaction to compare detail and search.
Assign owners for external reconciliation and monitoring duration.

exercises.referenceSolution: Run stable readiness, known catalog/search comparisons, controlled cart/checkout/order flow, payment and ERP reconciliation, authentication/authorization checks, queue/process checks, and a named elevated-monitoring period with explicit stop criteria.

exercises.title: Redesign the Release Gate
exercises.objective: Prevent recurrence through enforceable compatibility and recovery evidence.
exercises.initialState: The existing gate checks compilation, unit tests, and deployment approval but not migration or rollback evidence.
exercises.prompt: Design a release-control architecture that detects this failure before production and remains practical under the variant operating constraints.
constraints: do not promise universal zero downtime
exercises.deliverable: Control flow, evidence schema, approval rules, exception process, and effectiveness metrics.

hints.text: Make the compatibility declaration machine-readable.
Tie evidence to commit, build, schema fixture, and migration mode.
Measure escaped incompatibilities and rehearsal freshness, not only pipeline success.

exercises.referenceSolution: Gate persistent changes through classification, fresh production-like rehearsal, bidirectional compatibility and recovery checks, immutable evidence tied to build and schema, explicit exception ownership, and measures for escaped defects, stale fixtures, and untested recovery paths.

exercises.title: Write a Defensible Postmortem
exercises.objective: Separate trigger, contributing conditions, impact, recovery, and systemic prevention.
exercises.initialState: Service recovered through corrected roll-forward after a deployment mapping conflict.
exercises.prompt: Write the technical skeleton of a blameless postmortem using the variant impact, backup, support, and external-state constraints.
constraints: corrective actions need owners and verification
exercises.deliverable: Impact, timeline, causal analysis, recovery, detection gaps, corrective actions, and residual risks.

hints.text: A mapping conflict is a trigger; ask why it reached production.
Explain detection and decision latency without blaming responders.
Every action needs a verification method and due owner.

exercises.referenceSolution: Quantify impact and transaction divergence; identify the mapping conflict as trigger and stale rehearsal plus absent compatibility evidence as contributors; explain recovery; assign verifiable control changes; and record residual risk without blaming individuals.

exercises.title: Prepare the SAP Support Escalation Package
exercises.objective: Request managed-service assistance with sufficient, safe, decision-relevant evidence.
exercises.initialState: The team may need database recovery assistance and cannot use direct database access.
exercises.prompt: Prepare the escalation record and state exactly what customer teams have done, what remains unknown, and what assistance is requested under the variant support delay.
exercises.deliverable: Severity, impact, environment, build, migration, timeline, error, backup, actions, unknowns, and requested outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: specific support request and contact cadence

hints.text: Make the request actionable without granting database access.
Include what changed, what failed first, and which recovery paths were evaluated.
State the next communication time based on support delay and business impact.

exercises.referenceSolution: Provide impact/severity, environment and deployment identifiers, build/commit/mode, UTC timeline and first error, backup and schema evidence, customer actions and unknowns, the exact managed recovery assistance requested, and an agreed update cadence without secrets.
